$schema_note: MCP tool contracts for the parliament analysis agent. Keep tools deterministic; LLM prose stays in the host/summarizer.

tools.name: get_person_info
tools.description: Look up a politician by name (or DIP person id) and return identity, roles, and parliamentary group (Fraktion) affiliation. Use for questions like 'Who is Friedrich Merz?'.

query.description: Person name (e.g. 'Friedrich Merz') or numeric DIP person id.

wahlperiode.description: Optional legislative period used to pick the most relevant Fraktion when multiple roles exist. Defaults to 20.

matches.description: If the name is ambiguous, candidate matches for disambiguation.

notes.description: Data-quality caveats (missing Fraktion, conflicting roles, etc.).

tools.name: get_fraktion_distribution
tools.description: Compute parliamentary group (Fraktion) percentage shares for politicians in a legislative period. Use for questions like 'What is the parliamentary group distribution in the 20th legislative period?'.

include_unknown.description: If true, include people with missing/unclear Fraktion as 'Unknown'.

methodology.description: Short note on how affiliation was derived from DIP person_roles.

tools.name: summarize_fraktion_distribution
tools.description: Optional convenience tool: fetch distribution for a Wahlperiode and return an LLM-written natural-language summary. Prefer get_fraktion_distribution + host-side summarization when the chat host already has an LLM.
